<DESCRIPTION>
This uses a guarded win-stay/lose-shift core: it preserves mutually beneficial cooperation and repeats successful exploitation, while switching after poor outcomes. Inspired by history-responsive strategies, it adds a distinct early defector guard: if the opponent has never cooperated after several rounds, it permanently defects instead of falling into an unprofitable alternating pattern against unconditional defectors.
</DESCRIPTION>

<CODE>
```python
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def policy(own_history, opponent_history):
    return 0 if len(opponent_history) == 0 else 1 if len(opponent_history) > 2 and opponent_history.count(0) == 0 else own_history[-1] if opponent_history[-1] == 0 else 1 - own_history[-1]
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
```
